`D405_305_Mount.step` is used as the mechanical source for the derived mount. The upstream hardware is licensed under CERN-OHL-W-2.0; the copied `LICENSE` must remain with this source and the derived design.

To update it, retrieve an explicit upstream commit, verify the license and original path, replace only the required asset, record new hashes here, regenerate the release, and rerun all geometry checks.
